lines: Tum shahr mein ho to hamein kya gham, jab uthenge
couplets.en: With you in town, what sorrow could trouble me when I rise?

lines: Kehte hain ki Ghalib ka hai andaaz-e-bayaan aur
couplets.en: They say Ghalib has a way with words all his own.

lines: Hain aur bhi duniya mein sukhanwar bahut achchhe
couplets.en: There are other fine poets in the world.
